purpose: Verified scholarly admission sources for G5 constructs. Mapping does not itself approve a card; target-term lexical equivalence and card-specific claim-source mapping remain required.

sources.title: Self-report captures 27 distinct categories of emotion bridged by continuous gradients
sources.container: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.use_boundary: Supports distinct/graded emotion-category structure and category labels; does not by itself establish a non-English target term's lexical meaning or cultural usage.

sources.title: Approaching awe, a moral, spiritual, and aesthetic emotion
sources.use_boundary: Awe prototype emphasizes perceived vastness and need for accommodation; admiration is related but not identical.

sources.title: The grateful disposition: a conceptual and empirical topography
sources.container: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.use_boundary: Supports gratitude as a psychological construct/disposition; card-level state wording must remain conservative.

sources.title: The Unengaged Mind: Defining Boredom in Terms of Attention
sources.use_boundary: Boredom is treated as an aversive difficulty engaging in satisfying activity; avoid universal causal claims beyond the review.

sources.title: Compassion: an evolutionary analysis and empirical review
sources.use_boundary: Supports compassion as an affective response oriented to others' suffering; does not imply cultural universality of a specific lexical item.

sources.title: Moral emotions and moral behavior
sources.use_boundary: Supports distinctions among self-conscious moral emotions and selected positive moral emotions; avoid moral diagnosis of users.

sources.title: Embarrassment: its distinct form and appeasement functions
sources.use_boundary: Supports embarrassment as distinguishable from shame, guilt, and amusement.

sources.title: The psychological structure of pride: a tale of two facets
sources.container: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.use_boundary: Supports authentic/hubristic facets; a card must not flatten all pride into one moral valence.

sources.title: Perceived social isolation and cognition
sources.use_boundary: Supports loneliness/perceived social isolation as a psychological construct; do not equate it with objective solitude.

sources.title: Hope Theory: Rainbows in the Mind
sources.use_boundary: Hope theory defines agency/pathways cognition around desired goals; ordinary-language hope may be broader.

sources.title: Comprehending envy
sources.use_boundary: Supports definitional complexity including benign/hostile aspects; avoid assuming hostility is always present.

sources.title: Nostalgia: Past, Present, and Future
sources.use_boundary: Supports nostalgia as a self-relevant social emotion with mixed affect; target-language lexical meaning must be independently verified.

sources.title: Are shame, guilt, and embarrassment distinct emotions?
sources.container: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.use_boundary: Supports phenomenological distinctions; near-language terms should not be treated as interchangeable by default.
